title: MV Need a large Elk/Deer and a Moth SV enemy.

posts.author: FrozenFacade
posts.body:
Hey all, I'm looking for SV battlers in a style similar to some of the default engine sprites(Commercial). Currently I am in need of a large sinister looking moth enemy and a large Elk or Deer style enemy, both of which have been imbued with demonic energy. (I would also need overworld monster sprites for them as well.) I am willing to pay for assets even if they are in packs of things I do not need, and have some photoshop skills to be able to edit a regular moth or elk style enemy into what I want, as long as they as similar to the RPG maker style as a baseline.
Also since I am coming down to only needing a few harder to find sprites, if anybody knows somebody who takes commissions with a style similar to that of RPG maker I would be willing to look into that as well, thank you!
These are my current placeholder images....
